strategy.summary: The todos app (public/app.js, served by server.js) lets users tick todos complete, filter All/Active/Completed and clear completed todos. The tests prove, in a real browser against the real static server, that ticking and unticking update the strike-through and the items-left count, that each filter shows the right todos and is pressed, and that "Clear completed" is shown only while a todo is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Completing and un-completing todos (strike-through, items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
Visibility and effect of Clear completed
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in page memory only; the ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The app is a static page served by the repo's own server.js; it runs for real via playwright.config.js webServer. Nothing is faked: there is no backend API, todos live in page memory, so each test starts from an empty list on a fresh page and tests are independent.
"Struck through" is checked as the computed text-decoration line-through on the todo's title, which is how styles.css renders a completed todo; the checked checkbox is asserted too.
"Shown as pressed" means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others.
openQuestions: Should the completed state have an accessible signal beyond the checkbox (strike-through is visual only)?

risks.description: Count could be computed from visible (filtered) todos instead of all todos
risks.mitigation: TC3 also asserts the items-left count stays based on all todos while filtered.

risks.description: Clear completed could remove active todos or leave some completed ones
risks.mitigation: TC7 completes two of three todos and asserts only the active one remains.

risks.description: Unticking could leave stale strike-through or count

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: it is struck through and the items-left count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only non-completed todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo (and only those).

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
testCases.expected: 'Buy milk' checkbox checked, its title has line-through, 'Walk dog' not struck through, count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, no line-through, '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that aren't completed and is pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false; count still '1 item left'

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk']; Completed pressed, others not

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog']; All pressed, others not

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Tick it, assert Clear completed visible
testCases.expected: Clear completed hidden before ticking, visible after ticking, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: Refusal side: the action isn't offered when nothing is completed

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List shows exactly ['Walk dog'], '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.testData: Buy milk, Walk dog, Pay rent
testCases.rationale: Removes all completed (more than one) without touching active

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (existing config); no env vars or seed data. Browsers must be installed (`npx playwright install chromium`).
